propositions: Mirror Guard workflow replication check reds on a single instantaneous diverged sample during expected post-submit lag, causing false positives on normal replication behavior.

The module's design docstring delegates transient-lag absorption to the alarm layer's evaluation window, but the primary workflow watcher lacks this window while the secondary CloudWatch watcher implements it.

The persistence wrapper needs to re-sample diverged state across a multi-sample window (~90s, 3 attempts × 45s delay) and fail only when divergence persists, treating immediate convergence as self-healed transient lag.
On divergence, the check must distinguish between static GitHub tip (stalled replication, stays failed) and moving-but-not-converging tip (GitHub-ahead, stays failed).
In-process lag tolerance lives in the CLI module to satisfy portability; no CI-provider-specific state or retry logic required.
